tenders.title: Tender for detailed drone survey of 66kv transmission lines including AI analytics for predictive & preventive maintenance
tenders.scope_summary: This corrigendum relates to a tender for a detailed drone survey of 66kV transmission lines. The scope includes AI analytics of captured data to generate reports for predictive and preventive maintenance of the lines.
key_points: Detailed drone survey of 66kv transmission lines.
Generation of reports for predictive maintenance.
Generation of reports for preventive maintenance.
